page.layout: One page of text in a single column; verse quotations set indented in italic within the column; in the left margin, notes beside the last lines of the text.

main_text.p: hypocritæ peribit: non ei placebit vecordia sua, & sicut tela aranearum fiducia eius, innitetur super domum suam & non stabit: fulciet eam & non cöisurget: cui succinit Dauid Psal. 73. loquens de hypocritis qui ore & labiis Deo appropinquant, sed corde procul ab eo remoti sunt,
main_text.l: Qui te relictô, spe stolida deos
Te sectior vnum, tu superas meis
main_text.p: Iuris & legü hu manarü violatio nem.Quoties extensas videmus aranearum telas tanquam retia ad intercipiendam prædam: in memoriam reuocare debemus dictum illud Anacharsis: Leges similes esse aranearum telis, quibus minores quidem muscę capiuntur & constringuntur: sed quas maiores præteruolant, & facile perrumpunt. Ita etiam Magistratus facile se à potentioribus expugnari sinunt, in quorum gratiam iura & leges omnes violare & perfringere non dubitent: interea tamen

page.notes: The marginal note at left is set in small type, partly broken; read as "Iuris & legum violatio" with the line breaks as printed. Verse lines are italic in the scan; the Psalm 37 heading "Et Psalmo 37." is a line within the verse block. Several verse words are doubtful, e.g. "Specto"/"Spetto" and "Virescere", and are not marked with [?] individually.
